partsSearch.description: Supplier catalogs for the official parts-search plugin. VERA sends only the search text or part number to the suppliers you enable; credentials stay on this computer and are never shown to the agent. Searches also need Web access and the plugin enabled for the workbench. Results are snapshots without taxes or shipping, and nothing is ever ordered.

results.partial: The supplier answered; some results could not be read.
results.key-required: No credential is stored for this supplier.
results.rate-limited: The supplier's request limit was reached. Retry later.
results.timeout: The supplier did not answer in time.
results.unavailable: The supplier could not be reached.

mqttCredentials.description: Broker logins for the official mqtt-tools plugin. A broker profile in the workbench names a credential by its reference; VERA hands the username and password only to an approved mqtt-tool run of the plugin enabled for that workbench, on the program's input, never in its arguments, environment, logs or results. The agent never sees them.
mqttCredentials.referenceHint: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, as the broker profile's credential field names it.

wokwiTokens.description: Wokwi CI tokens for the official wokwi plugin, which runs firmware simulations in Wokwi's cloud. A simulation job names a token by its reference; VERA hands the token only to an approved wokwi-tool run of the plugin enabled for that workbench, on the program's input, never in its arguments, logs or results. The agent never sees it. Each cloud run sends the job's firmware and diagram to Wokwi and counts against your Wokwi plan.
wokwiTokens.referenceHint: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, as the simulation job's account names it.

workbenchTools.hint: Checked tools are enabled for this workbench. Changes take effect after you save; session permissions still apply.
workbenchTools.read: Read text files or selected line ranges.
workbenchTools.list: List files and subfolders in a directory.
workbenchTools.glob: Find files by name or path patterns, such as **/*.cpp.
workbenchTools.grep: Search file contents, including regular expressions.
workbenchTools.write: Create text files or replace their contents.
workbenchTools.edit: Replace exact text in a previously read file.
workbenchTools.artifact_save: Save a text result as a session artifact.
workbenchTools.todo: Manage the session's task list in Plan.
workbenchTools.read_doc: Read extracted document pages, sections or text lines.
workbenchTools.load_skill: Load instructions and supporting text from an enabled skill.
workbenchTools.web_search: Search the public web using the provider selected in Settings → Web access. Access requirements and service limits depend on the provider.
workbenchTools.web_read: Retrieve text from public web pages and supported documents using the selected web provider. No local file is saved.
workbenchTools.parse_log: Parse captured ESP-IDF, Zephyr or ISO logs into counts and cited events.
workbenchTools.web_download: Download a public file (PDF, ZIP, CSV, text, images or other formats) to .vera/downloads, subject to session permissions. Preview PDFs in VERA or locate other files in Explorer. Downloads are not automatically indexed.
workbenchTools.run_program: Run programs of the plugins enabled for this workbench, with the plugin's risk rules and your approvals.
workbenchTools.program_output: Read the output of a background program run.
workbenchTools.plugin_validate: Validate a plugin draft and report schema issues and warnings.
workbenchTools.plugin_install: Request review and install a draft as a trial plugin.
workbenchTools.apply_candidate: Write a checked kicad-layout candidate over its source board after you ask to apply it. Needs the kicad-layout plugin; asks for approval like a write.
workbenchTools.decode_register: Decode a captured register value using a local JSON definition, with exact field values and cited sources. Reads no device.
workbenchTools.parts_search: Search the enabled supplier catalogs (Mouser, DigiKey, TME, Farnell, Rutronik) by keyword or part number. Needs Web access, the parts-search plugin and a supplier set up in the plugin's Configuration on the Plugins page.
